payload.title: File:Stenopterygius triscissus SW.png
payload.description_html:
Life restoration of the Early Jurassic parvipelvian ichthyosaur Stenopterygius triscissus. This reconstruction is based primarily on SMNS 14846, with BMK 813 B (lectotype of S. "megalorhinus") and NHMUK 33157 (S. "longifrons"). The soft tissue outline was based on that of S. quadriscissus, while the coloration was based on other Stenopterygius specimens.

References

  • Maxwell, E.E. (2012). "New metrics to differentiate species of Stenopterygius (Reptilia: Ichthyosauria) from the Lower Jurassic of southwestern Germany". Journal of Paleontology 86 (1): 105–115.
  • Maisch, M.W. (2008). "Revision of the genus Stenopterygius Jaekel, 1904 emend. von Huene, 1922 (Reptilia: Ichthyosauria) from the Lower Jurassic of Western Europe". Palaeodiversity 1: 227–271.
  • Eriksson, M.E.; De La Garza, R.; Horn, E.; Lindgren, J. (2022). "A review of ichthyosaur (Reptilia, Ichthyopterygia) soft tissues with implications for life reconstructions". Earth-Science Reviews 226: 103965. DOI:10.1016/j.earscirev.2022.103965.
  • Owen, R. (1881). "Monograph on the fossil Reptilia of the Liassic Formations. Part 3. Ichthyopterygia". Palaeontographical Society Monographs 35: 83–134.
  • Drevermann, F. (1914). "Die Meeressaurier im Senckenbergischen Museum". Bericht der Senckenbergischen Naturforschenden Gesellschaft in Frankfurt am Main 45: 35–48.
